description: This file contains Perl test scripts for the Coocook schema, including tests for database connection, statistics, foreign key checks, and result set behaviors using Test2::V0 framework.

methods.name: TestDB->new
methods.description: Creates a new test database instance.

methods.name: $db->count
methods.description: Returns the count of records in the database or specific tables.

methods.name: $rs->first
methods.description: Retrieves the first record from a result set.

methods.name: $rs->one_row
methods.description: Retrieves a single row from the result set.

methods.name: $db->statistics
methods.description: Returns statistics about the database schema.

methods.name: Coocook::Schema->connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection with various configurations.

methods.name: $schema->storage->dbh->ping
methods.description: Checks if the database handle is active.

methods.name: $schema->sqlite_pragma
methods.description: Gets or sets SQLite PRAGMA settings.

methods.name: $dbh->selectrow_array
methods.description: Executes a query and returns a single row as an array.

methods.name: $row->insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database.

methods.name: $row->delete
methods.description: Deletes a record from the database.

methods.name: $projects->next
methods.description: Advances the result set cursor to the next record.

methods.name: $projects->assert_no_sth
methods.description: Asserts that the statement handle is no longer active.
